snippet.title: [ SHREYA ROUTE ] Choices The Elementalists Book 3 Chapter 1 💎
snippet.description:
Choices: The Elementalists Book 3 Chapter 1 Shreya Route (Diamonds used)

First chapter was pretty good!
MC's previous book hairstyle wasn't doing him justice so had to make him look good lmao (did not realize later it's gonna make him a kpop idol 😭)

Atlas not winning this lmao 💀 like bro changes his goal each chapter and definitely is not the suitable candidate for high attuned with how the power goes into his head sometimes.

I believe this could later cause much tensions between the sibling pair and which i would love to see to be honest. no more of that disney stuff, sh*t gets real now.

also making the high attuned competition announcement to the friends and beckett looked so taken aback initially. i know buddy got jealous and was crying inside a little that he didn't get chosen for it 😭 (he definitely deserves his flowers for how he helped back in book 1 and 2 tho)

since power choices were chosen for book 2 in shreya's route i'll hunt for the high attuned win in shreya route while go for the peace route in aster's route. 

UPDATE: it looks like the book is vip only right now so aster route goes live when the book is available for public release as i don’t have vip on the other account. In the meantime i will complete the blades 3 other route and the 13th house episodes

Thanks for Watching 😄
